result.title: DAPointRWKV: Domain Adaptive Vision RWKV for Point Cloud Completion
result.comment: This paper has been accepted by 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia
result.summary: Domain adaptive point cloud completion (DA PCC) aims to bridge the geometric discrepancy between labeled source domains and unlabeled target domains for accurate 3D shape completion. Existing methods based on CNNs, Transformers, and Mamba-like sequence models still face challenges from limited receptive fields, high computational complexity, insufficient geometric bias, and serialization sensitivity. Recently, Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) provides a linear-complexity alternative for long-range sequence modeling. However, adapting RWKV to DA PCC remains challenging due to the lack of explicit geometric priors, the mismatch between recurrent modeling and coarse-to-fine generation, and unstable target-domain adaptation. To address these challenges, we propose DAPointRWKV, a novel RWKV-based framework for DA PCC. DAPointRWKV consists of three components: Geometry-Aware RWKV (GA-RWKV) Backbone, RWKV-Oriented Progressive Decoder (RWKV-PD), and Dual Structural Regularization (DSR). Specifically, GA-RWKV introduces geometry-aware recurrent representation learning, RWKV-PD bridges RWKV token representations with coarse-to-fine reconstruction through local token-guided refinement, and DSR stabilizes target-domain transfer through visible-structure anchoring and complete-shape hypothesis stabilization. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that DAPointRWKV consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DAPointRWKV，用几何感知 RWKV 主干、渐进解码器和双结构正则化完成跨域点云补全。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究重点是 3D 形状补全的域自适应生成，未涉及视觉推理中的 latent 证据使用、动态计算或停止决策，RWKV 循环状态也仅服务于几何重建，缺少可核查的 LVR 联系。
